name: @paniniapi/browser
description: Browser-safe Panini bundle — narration parsing, CSV/SMS statement extraction and deterministic insights with all grammar/dictionary data inlined. Zero node: imports; nothing leaves the page.
author: Kapil

scripts.build: npm run generate && tsc -b && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --alias:node:fs=./scripts/fs-stub.js --alias:node:path=./scripts/fs-stub.js --alias:node:zlib=./scripts/fs-stub.js --alias:node:crypto=./scripts/fs-stub.js --format=esm --outfile=dist/panini.browser.mjs && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --alias:node:fs=./scripts/fs-stub.js --alias:node:path=./scripts/fs-stub.js --alias:node:zlib=./scripts/fs-stub.js --alias:node:crypto=./scripts/fs-stub.js --format=cjs --outfile=dist/panini.browser.cjs && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --alias:node:fs=./scripts/fs-stub.js --alias:node:path=./scripts/fs-stub.js --alias:node:zlib=./scripts/fs-stub.js --alias:node:crypto=./scripts/fs-stub.js --format=iife --global-name=panini --outfile=dist/panini.browser.global.js
